reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Defined liposome NT/FL/CT and cleavage comparison, size/EM corroboration and a cellular osmoprotection/mutant bridge.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

Active caspase alone and matched cleavage-buffer/carryover controls are absent from the cleavage-activation comparison. The cellular binding-deficient mutant bridge also lacks a required folding/abundance check; charge the combined prospective-control criterion once.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.
Spontaneous-release and positive-pore thresholds are useful, but there is no free-reporter-plus-protein interference/recovery calibration or quantitative fluorescence dynamic-range check.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.

checks.quote: small osmoprotectants block cell swelling, large ones do not
checks.reason: The size-exclusion osmoprotection prediction is reversed and repeated in the required cellular cross-check. Excluded extracellular polymers larger than a permeant pore can sustain osmotic protection; smaller permeating solutes generally cannot. Primary experimental support: https://link.springer.com/article/10.15252/embj.201694696 . Count this once, not again as G1/P13.
A concentration/lipid/time range is proposed without a bounded ladder or concrete derivation of bounds, an objective selection criterion and a lock before independent confirmation.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.

Two repeat failures do not distinguish technical from biological causes. Similarly, failure of the lipid scan and fraction rescue does not establish indirect physiology as the primary mechanism; a remaining reagent/context limitation is not resolved by repetition.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

historical_match_reason: The positive primary branch includes purified NT membrane action, independently assessed rings/structures and functional size cutoff with explicit fragment/irrelevant-protein controls. These jointly match all five historical components.
